items.title: Carnell Tate: Expected back for Week 11
items.text:
Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that he's hopeful that Tate (shoulder) will return to action Week 11 versus the Cowboys, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drake Maye: Ankle fracture feared
items.text:
The Patriots are concerned that Maye fractured his ankle during Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brock Bowers: Viewed as day-to-day with ankle injury
items.text:
Bowers, who will undergo additional testing Monday, is not believed to have suffered a major ankle injury in Sunday's loss to the Seahawks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drake Maye: May have significant lower-leg inury
items.text:
Maye is believed to have sustained a significant lower-leg injury in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich that could sideline him for an extended period of time, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DK Metcalf: Gets into end zone in loss
items.text:
Metcalf brought in two of six targets for 54 yards and a touchdown and added a two-point conversion catch in the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday night.
